description: Returns current vs. average travel times for named WA highway corridors (I-5, I-405, I-90, SR 520, SR 167, and around Vancouver I-205 and SR 14). Use for "how congested is I-5?" or commute time estimates. A route designation filter ("I-5", "5", "SR 520") returns every corridor that starts or ends on that route or writes it in its name ("via 520"), never digits inside another number. Any other filter text matches corridor names ("Everett"), and the first number in it, read as a route, also matches every corridor that starts or ends on that route, in both directions — "I-405 southbound" returns northbound I-405 corridors too, since the direction word is not applied. When current time exceeds average, the corridor is congested. Results are paged — pass offset/limit to page through the full set.

limit.description: Maximum corridors to return in this page. Defaults to 50; a larger value returns at most 500 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first corridor to return, for paging. Defaults to 0.

route.description: Optional filter. A route designation — an optional route type (I, SR, US) and the route number, such as "I-5", "5", "005", "SR 520", or "520" — matches every corridor whose start or end point is on that route, whichever form the feed reports, or whose name writes the route ("I-5", "SR14", "via 520"). It never matches digits inside another number: "5" does not match I-405 or SR 522. Any other text matches the corridor name as a case-insensitive substring, so "Everett" finds the Seattle-Everett corridors and "1A" the 1A segments. The first number in such text, read as a route with any route type written just before it, also matches every corridor whose start or end point is on that route, in both directions — "I-405 southbound" returns northbound I-405 corridors too, since the direction word is not applied. Omit to return all corridors.

name: wsdot_get_travel_times

corridors.description: Travel time corridors matching the filter.

items.description: Travel time data for one highway corridor.

averageTimeInMinutes.description: Historical average travel time in minutes. Absent when WSDOT reports no measurement for the corridor.

currentTimeInMinutes.description: Current travel time in minutes. Absent when WSDOT reports no measurement for the corridor — a reversible express lane closed in this direction reports none.

delayInMinutes.description: Delay above average in minutes. Positive means congestion. Absent when either travel time is unavailable.

direction.description: Travel direction code: N (north), S (south), E (east), W (west).
Travel direction code: N (north), S (south), E (east), W (west).

timeUpdated.description: When the travel time data was last updated (ISO 8601).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: WSDOT Traffic API is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response after retries. `invalid_access_code`: WSDOT rejected the request because WSDOT_ACCESS_CODE is missing, invalid, or not registered. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more corridors remain beyond the current page.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass to retrieve the next page, or null when this is the last page.

notice.description: Informational note about the page window, or guidance when no corridors matched the route filter or the offset ran past the end. Ends with the applied limit when a larger one was clamped.

routeFilter.description: The route name filter applied (lowercased), or absent if no filter was used.

totalCount.description: Total corridors matching the filter across all pages (not just this page).
